mapper.select: SELECT * FROM im_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1

SELECT c.conversation_id, c.target_id, IFNULL(u.nick_name, u.user_name) AS target_name, u.avatar AS target_avatar, c.last_msg_content, c.last_msg_time, c.unread_count FROM im_conversation c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = c.target_id AND u.del_flag = '0' WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY c.last_msg_time DESC, c.conversation_id DESC
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(unread_count), 0) FROM im_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0'
